author: IamMrTitan
quote: Bru. I don't even know what to say. I wanted this game to be good. I'm 80 percent done and I want to go back to waiting for GTA VI again. That was more fun. I can't wait to see the user score go up from the buying bots to rank it. There is zero chance the critic scores are not paid. Trash. Trash. Trash.
